scope: Maintain the persistence, entity render/model, entity behavior/API, egg/hatching, and dynamic item-model migrations present at frozen legacy checkpoint 63a8b46ac939d6bd48e21d4840c480361ad852ef.

Matcha-specific spawn tuning or other new gameplay policy during the preservation port.
